responsibility: Declares the substitution visitors that rewrite TyTy types with generic arguments. It separates external generic-argument application, internal substitution using SubstitutionArgumentMappings, reconstruction from an existing instantiated type, and discovery of used substitution arguments, providing the glue between path/type resolution and the substitution-aware TyTy classes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the mapper visitor classes for applying, reapplying, and inspecting substitutions across TyTy nodes; the .cc companion provides the actual per-type visitor behavior and context-updating implementation.
